summary: Southern California Edison Co filed an 8-K reporting the sale of $500M principal amount of 4.95% First and Refunding Mortgage Bonds, Series 2026B, due 2031. The bonds were issued under a supplemental indenture dated May 5, 2026, with underwriting agreement among Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, and Truist Securities. The filing is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. Terms include 4.95% coupon, 2031 maturity, and mortgage bond structure secured by first and refunding lien. No special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or activist activity. The transaction is a standard capital markets financing.
